questions.question: The area of the sheet metal needed to make a box of size 7 cm × 8 cm × 9 cm is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Length of the box = 7 cm

Breadth of the box = 8 cm

Height of the box = 9 cm

**Formula Used:**

The Total Surface area of the box = 2(lb + bh + lh)

**Calculation:**

⇒ The Total Surface area of the box = 2(7 × 8 + 8 × 9 + 9 × 7)

⇒ 2(56 + 72 + 63)

⇒ 2 × 191

⇒ **382 cm²**

questions.question: Age of A is 6 years more than three times the age of B. After three years. A’s age will be 8 years more than twice the age of B. The average of present ages of A and B (in years) is:
questions.solution:
Let the age of A be a years.

The age of B be b years.

⇒ a = 6 + 3b ----(1)

After 3 years,

a + 3 = 8 + 2(b + 3)

⇒ a + 3 = 8 + 2b + 6

⇒ a – 2b = 11 ----(2)

On solving eq. 1 and 2,

We get,

⇒ B = 5 years

⇒ A = 21 years

∴ The average age of A and B = (21 + 5)/2 = 26/2 = 13 years

questions.question: A boat takes 80 minutes to row 12 km upstream and 60 minutes to row 15 km downstream. How long will it take to row a distance of 36 km in still water?
questions.solution:
Speed of boat upstream = (12/80) × 60 = 9 km/hr

Speed of boat downstream = (15/60) × 60 = 15 km/hr

Speed of boat in still water = (15 + 9)/2 = 12 km/hr.

∴ Time taken to row a distance of 36 km = 36/12 = 3 hrs.

questions.question: A work can be completed by 35 workers in 30 days. If 5 workers leave after every 10 days then in how many days will the work be completed?
questions.solution:
Total work = 35 × 30 = 1050 unit

First 10 days work by 35 workers = 35 × 10 = 350

Remaining work = 1050 – 350 = 700 units

Next 10 days work by 30 workers = 30 × 10 = 300

Remaining work = 700 – 300 = 400 units

Next 10 days work by 25 workers = 25 × 10 = 250

Remaining work = 400 – 250 = 150

The remaining work to be completed by 20 workers = 150/20 = 7.5 days

∴ The total time taken to complete the work = 10 + 10 + 10 + 7.5 = 37.5 days

questions.question: The diagonal of the square measures 6√2 cm. The measure of the diagonal of a square whose area is twice that of the first square is.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The diagonal of the square = 6√2 cm

**Calculation:**

The side of the first square = 6 cm (By Pythagoras theorem)

Area of first square = 6 × 6 = 36 cm²

Area of second square = 2 × 36 = 72 cm²

The side of the second square = √72 = 6√2

Now,

The diagonal of second square = √(2 × area of square)

⇒ √(2 × 72)

⇒ √144 = 12 cm

**∴The diagonal of the second square is 12cm**

questions.question: If a : b = 2 : 3 and b : c = 2 : 3, then what is the value of (3a² + b² – c²) : (a² + 2b² – c²)?
questions.solution:
The ratio (a : b : c) = 4 : 6 : 9

The required ratio = (3a² + b² – c²) : (a² + 2b² – c²)

⇒ (3 × 4² + 6² – 9²) : (4² + 2 × 6² – 9²)

⇒ 3 : 7

questions.question: If 80% of X is 36 more than 60% of Y and 120% of X is equal to Y, then the difference between X and Y is:
questions.solution:
According to question,

80% of X = 36 + 60% of Y

⇒ 0.8X – 0.6Y = 36 ----(1)

Now,

120% of X = Y

⇒ 1.2X = Y ----(2)

On solving Eq. 1 and Eq. 2,

X = 450

Y = 540

∴ The difference between X and Y = 540 – 450 = 90

questions.question: A woman travelling at 130% of her usual speed reached her office 12 minute early. Her usual time to cover the journey is:
questions.solution:
Let the speed be 10x

The new speed is 13x

The usual time be t.

According to question,

10xt = 13x(t – 12/60)

⇒ 10t = 13t – 13/5

⇒ -3t = -13/5

⇒ t = 13/15 = 0.87 hr

questions.question: The volume of a prism is 308 cm³ and the height is 11 cm. The base area of the prism is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The volume of a prism is 308 cm3 and the height is 11 cm.

**Formula used:**

The volume of the prism = area of its base × height

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

308 = area of its base × 11

area of its base = 308/11 = 28cm²

**∴ Area of base = 308/11 = 28 cm²**

questions.question: The largest three digit number that is exactly divisible by 6, 7 and 8 is:
questions.solution:
Factors of 6 = 2 × 3

Factors of 7 = 7

Factors of 8 = 2 × 2 × 2

L.C.M. of (6, 7, 8) = 168

∴ The largest 3 digit number = 168 × 5 = 840

questions.question: The average of 10 numbers is P and the average of 4 of these numbers is Q. If the average of remaining numbers is R then which of the following is correct.
questions.solution:
The total of 10 numbers = 10 × P = 10P

The total of 4 numbers = 4 × Q = 4Q

The total of remaining 6 numbers = 6 × R = 6R

According to question,

The total of 10 numbers = The total of 4 numbers + The total of remaining 6 numbers

⇒ 10P = 4Q + 6R

∴ 5P = 2Q + 3R

questions.question: Parikh sold his pen at a profit of Rs. 11. He calculated the profit percentage on selling price and found it to be 25%. The cost price (in Rs.) of the pen is:
If an article is sold at 23% profit instead of 14% profit, then the profit would be Rs. 189 more. What is the cost price?
questions.solution:
Let the C.P. be x

Difference in profit% = 23% – 14% = 9% of x

Difference in profit = 189

According to question,

9% of x = 189

⇒ x = 189 × 100/9

⇒ x = 2100

∴ C.P. of article = Rs. 2100

questions.question: A bag contains ten rupee, five rupee and two rupee notes in the ratio 10 : 5 : 2. The total value of five rupee notes in the bag is Rs. 84 more than that of two rupee notes. The total value of ten rupee notes in the bag (in Rs.) is:
questions.solution:
Let the number of ten rupee, five rupee and two rupee notes be 10x, 5x, 2x.

The total value of five rupee notes = 5 × 5x = 25x

The total value of two rupee notes = 2 × 2x = 4x

The difference between value of 5 rupee and 2 rupee notes = 25x – 4x = 21x

According to question,

21x = 84

⇒ x = 84/21 = 4

∴ The total value of 10 rupee notes = 10 × 10x = 100 × 4 = 400

questions.question: After allowing a discount of 12.5% shopkeeper makes a profit of 25% on a bag. At what percent higher than the cost price did he mark the bag? (correct to nearest integer)
questions.solution:
Let the marked price be Rs. x.

Let the cost price of bag be Rs. 100.

The selling price at which he made profit of 25% = 100 + 25 = Rs. 125

The marked price at which he gave a discount of 12.5% or 1/8 = 7x/8 = 125

The marked price = x = 125 × 8/7

⇒ x = 142.8 = 143

The percent higher than the C.P. = 143 – 100 = 43%

questions.question: A sum doubles in 4 years at a certain rate of compound interest. In how many years does it amount to 8 times itself at the same rate?
questions.solution:
Let the principal be Rs. P.

P(1 + r/100)ⁿ = 2P

⇒ (1 + r/100)⁴ = 2 ----(1)

Now,

P(1 + r/100)ⁿ = 8P

⇒ (1 + r/100)ⁿ = 2³ ----(2)

Using eq. 1 on cubing both sides,

(1 + r/100)⁴ × ³ = 2³

⇒ (1 + r/100)¹² = 2³

∴ n = 12 years

questions.question: A certain sum amount to Rs. 20720 in four years and Rs. 24080 in six years at a certain rate of simple interest. The sum (in Rs.) is:
questions.solution:
The two years difference in interest = 24080 – 20720 = Rs. 3360

⇒ Simple interest for 1 year = 3360/2 = Rs. 1680

⇒ Simple interest for 4 years = 1680 × 4 = Rs. 6720

∴ The principal = 20720 – 6720 = Rs. 14000
